title: Keyhole Portal in Enchanted Forest
description: A blue-skinned figure with white hair in a red robe sits on a mossy log in an enchanted forest, holding a white lotus flower and gazing at a giant ornate keyhole portal. The portal reveals a swirling purple vortex with floating blue books, glowing orbs, and a luminous white lotus at its center, framed by an intricate silver border with purple gems under a starry night sky with aurora lights.
prompt: A mystical scene in an enchanted forest with ancient mossy trees and hanging vines under a purple night sky with aurora lights. In the foreground, a blue-skinned humanoid figure with white hair wearing a long red robe sits on a fallen log, holding a glowing white lotus flower to their face. In the center stands a giant ornate keyhole-shaped portal with intricate silver and purple gem-encrusted frame, revealing a swirling purple vortex inside with floating blue books, glowing particles, and a large luminous white lotus flower at the center. The atmosphere is magical and surreal with soft glowing lights and detailed foliage.
